entities.summary: Djordje Djokovic is a Serbian former tennis player and tournament director of the Serbia Open, held at his brother Novak's Novak Tennis Center. He is the youngest son of Dijana and Srđan Đoković. He is the younger brother of Novak and Marko Djokovic.
